description: rnaseq's merged gene counts and the gene lengths of the same quantification become differentialabundance's --matrix and --feature-length-matrix (DESeq2 models length bias with them; differentialabundance does not recommend raw counts without lengths) — from the alignment-based quantification when rnaseq ran one, otherwise its pseudo-aligner — with the GTF the rnaseq run used. An rnaseq release that published no lengths for that quantification (before 3.15.0; RSEM before 3.23.0) fails the handoff: hand over its length-scaled counts with an inline handoff instead. The experimental design (--input, sample names as in rnaseq) and --contrasts describe your study and go in the stage's own params.
